(`unzip -p __KEY__-X.Y.Z.jar META-INF/grow/__KEY__/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/__KEY__/ · Service: __DISPLAY__ · Categories: __CATEGORIES__ ·
Package `codes.grow.packages.__PKG__`.

<!-- @sdk-kit:if secrets -->

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```java
import codes.grow.packages.__PKG__.secrets.ConfigLoader;
Map<String, String> config =
    ConfigLoader.load(ConfigLoader.LoadOptions.builder().required("DATABASE_URL").build());
```

- `ConfigLoader.load(LoadOptions)` / `load()` → `Map<String, String>`; Java cannot change the process
  environment, so values go to **system properties** (or `LoadOptions.target(BiConsumer)`); Spring reads
  system properties.
- Bootstrap: `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `__KEY__`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`, `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`. Missing required keys
  → `NotFoundException`. No bootstrap or `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1` → only the required check.
- Also: `ConfigLoader.loadFrom(provider, path, options)`, `readBootstrap(env)`, `secretsPreloaded(env)`.
<!-- @sdk-kit:endif -->

## Logging: one call

```java
import codes.grow.packages.__PKG__.logging.LoggingInit;
LoggingInit.LoggingHandle log =
    LoggingInit.initLogging(LoggingInit.InitOptions.builder().service("orders").build());
log.logger().info("started");
// servlet / Spring Boot: new RequestLoggingFilter(log.logger()); Logback: GrowLogbackAppender with log.client()
```

- JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`, `trace_id`, attributes,
  redacted); with `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=__KEY__` also shipped (`log_shipped:"sdk"`, failed exports re-emitted
  with `"sdk_failed"`). Handle: `logger()`, `client()`, `shipped()`, `flush()`, `close()`, `canary(msg, attrs)`.
- `LoggingInit.withRequestId(id, runnable)`, `currentRequestId()`.
